author: feral-core
description: What FERAL has learned about individual websites. Recall per-domain browser knowledge (which dropdowns are fake, which buttons sit under overlays, which steps hide in cross-origin iframes) before automating a site, and file new observations after. Everything stored here is prose data that the agent reads; nothing stored here is ever executed.
trigger_phrases: what do you know about this site
what did we learn about this website

endpoints.description: Look up everything FERAL already knows about a site BEFORE automating it. Call this with the target URL as the first step of any browser task so you do not rediscover known traps. Returns host-specific notes first, then registrable-domain notes, then general interaction techniques.

params.name: url
params.description: Target URL or hostname, e.g. https://admin.shopify.com/store/x or admin.shopify.com

params.name: topic
params.description: Restrict to one topic, e.g. not_native_select, cross_origin_iframe, dialogs, uploads, click_intercepted

endpoints.returns_description: {host, domain, scope_chain, notes[], briefing} — briefing is a short markdown block written for the agent to read.

endpoints.description: File a durable note about a site you just worked out by hand: the real selector for a custom widget, the hidden step in a checkout, the order a form must be filled in. Stored as prose and replayed to you on the next visit. It is never executed, so describe the technique rather than shipping a script.

params.name: url
params.description: URL or hostname the note applies to. Defaults to host scope (admin.shopify.com), which is usually what you want. Pass 'domain:example.com' to apply it to every subdomain, or 'global' for a technique true of all sites.

params.name: title
params.description: One-line summary, e.g. 'Country dropdown is a listbox overlay, not a select'

params.name: body
params.description: The actual knowledge: what fails, why, and what to do instead.

params.name: topic
params.description: Short topic key for grouping, e.g. not_native_select, login, checkout, uploads

endpoints.description: Full-text-ish search across every site note, when you know the symptom but not the site.

params.name: query
params.description: Text to match against titles, bodies, topics and hostnames

endpoints.description: List every site FERAL has notes about, with note and observation counts.
Size and shape of the site-knowledge store, including how many recurring failures are ready to propose to Tool Genesis.

Recurring per-site failures that have been seen enough times to be worth building a real helper for. Returns PROPOSAL TEXT ONLY for a human to review: it does not generate code and does not execute anything. Building an actual tool from one of these must go through Tool Genesis approval.

params.name: min_observations
params.description: Minimum times the failure must have been seen (default 3)

endpoints.returns_description: {count, candidates[]} — each candidate carries requires_human_approval=true and auto_execute=false.

endpoints.description: Delete one site note by id, for when a site changes and the note is now wrong.
